svg.text: ONE VISUAL STRING, NOT CHARACTER ELEMENTS.
THE CURRENT STRING DETERMINES FLOW WIDTH.
WHITESPACE IS PRESERVED AT EVERY STEP.
ITS VISUAL COLLAPSE FOLLOWS CALLER CSS.
FINAL TEXT HAS A SEPARATE LIVE REGION.
ABSOLUTE SR-ONLY BOX ADDS NO FLOW WIDTH.
REVEAL RESTARTS WHEN TEXT / INTERVAL CHANGE.
EACH EFFECT CLEANS UP ITS INTERVAL.
TYPE, WRAPPING AND WIDTH POLICY INHERIT.
NO SURFACE, BORDER, RADIUS OR SHADOW.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · NO FIXED CHARACTER CELLS
ROOT: SPAN · INLINE-BLOCK · NATIVE PROPS / REF
VISUAL CHILD: SPAN · ARIA-HIDDEN = TRUE · ONE TEXT NODE
SCHEMATIC PLANES · SEPARATION DOES NOT IMPLY Z-INDEX
VISIBLE STRING CHANGES; THE LIVE REGION DOES NOT SCRAMBLE.
THE UPPER PLANE IS EXPLANATORY: SR-ONLY IS CLIPPED.
NO SHADOW ENVELOPE OR SURFACE STACK EXISTS.
DETAIL A · WIDTH IS NOT RESERVED
PROPORTIONAL STATES · NOT A TEXT-WIDTH SPECIFICATION
NO HIDDEN FULL-SIZE MEASURER; NO MIN-WIDTH RESERVE.
W(t) CAN CHANGE AS SYMBOL ADVANCES CHANGE. WRAPPING IS CALLER-DEFINED.
Rk = min(N, k·Q) Q = max(1, ceil(N / M))
K = ceil(N / Q) ≤ M T = K·I ≤ 48·32 = 1536ms (DEFAULT)
Tailwind sr-only; inspector demo and landing preview.
Survey: two live call sites + five test instances.
After fonts / hydration: demo F = 18px, LH ≈ 26px;
Specimen type is inherited, not a component constant.
TICK: LOCK PREFIX; REGENERATE REMAINING SYMBOLS.
COMPLETE: CLEAR TIMER; DISPLAY FINAL STRING.
TEXT OR INTERVAL CHANGE: CLEAN UP, THEN RESTART.
REDUCED MOTION IS CHECKED AT EFFECT START.
NO CSS EASING OR DURATION TOKEN DRIVES TICKS.
